card: This pull request passes Bitcoin Core's compiler and linker hardening flags to the embedded libsecp256k1 subtree build by re-introducing a `hardening_interface` CMake target. Previously, secp256k1 objects were built without flags like stack protection and branch protection. Because linkers drop binary-wide control-flow integrity flags if even a single linked object lacks them, secp256k1 objects stripped control-flow markers from release binaries on toolchains that do not enable them by default. Testing on Ubuntu 26.04 with GCC 15 confirms this change restores the `AArch64 feature: BTI, PAC, GCS` elf note on bitcoind.
changed_since_previous: Diff provided; the implementation matches the previous description.
evidence: Author notes: 'On aarch64 Ubuntu 26.04 with GCC 15 this also costs the whole binary its control flow property: master\'s bitcoind has no AArch64 feature note, and the three secp256k1 objects are the only ones in the build tree without it.'
Author verifies: 'With it, the same build shows AArch64 feature: BTI, PAC, GCS on bitcoind.'
problem: The secp256k1 subtree does not inherit flags from `core_interface`, so its objects are built without hardening flags such as FORTIFY, stack protection, stack clash protection, and branch/control-flow protection unless compiler defaults provide them. Because linkers drop binary-wide control-flow protection markers (like AArch64 BTI/PAC/GCS or x86_64 CET) if any linked object lacks them, the unhardened secp256k1 objects cause the final executable to lose hardware control-flow protections.

risk.why: Passing additional compiler and linker flags to libsecp256k1 could cause build failures on esoteric platforms or toolchain configurations.

scope_notes: Small build-system change reverting commit 77e553ab6a to re-introduce `hardening_interface` and forward its options to `cmake/secp256k1.cmake`.
summary: Move compiler and linker hardening flags into a dedicated CMake interface library (`hardening_interface`) linked by `core_interface`, and pass those flags down to the secp256k1 subtree build.
